newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Fishermen missing after Fiji cyclone, two dead.
newsitem.headline: Fishermen missing after Fiji cyclone, two dead.

text.p: A search and rescue operation was under way off the coast of Fiji on Sunday for up to 10 fishermen missing since a tropical cyclone hammered the South Pacific nation late last week, rescue officials said.

Disaster coordinator Tui Fagaleli told Reuters from the capital Suva that the confirmed death toll from cyclone Gavin was two, but other reports said five people were killed when the storm roared past northwestern Fiji on Thursday and Friday.
Fagaleli, of the National Emergency Operations Centre, said one woman died on the northern island of Vuana Levu and another woman was crushed to death by a falling tree.

A boat carrying as many as 10 fishermen was missing off the island of Vatulele, and Fagaleli said a New Zealand Orion rescue plane had joined two Fijian naval vessels in the search for survivors on Sunday.

He said the fishermen had apparently been heading for shelter when the cyclone -- which produced top winds of 240 kph (150 mph) -- hit the area. Another boat carrying four fishermen hasd been missing since before the cyclone warning.
The cyclone destroyed scores of houses, and damage reports were still being collated.
